paper.title_en: Scalar-induced gravitational waves from inflation with symmetry breaking
paper.abstract_en: We investigate scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) in an inflationary model with symmetry breaking, in which charged scalar fields are coupled to an isotropic triplet of Abelian gauge fields through a kinetic function. Such SIGWs can be enhanced to a detectable level when the mixing between the inflaton and gauge-field perturbations is sufficiently large. We find that the longitudinal mode and the charge-dependent mixing between perturbations become relevant only when the gauge-field excitation occurs sufficiently late during inflation. In this regime, the corresponding SIGWs are shifted to ultra-high frequencies, typically can around the GHz band. We show that the parameters characterizing the effects of the longitudinal mode and charge-dependent mixing affect the signal in qualitatively different ways. This provides characteristic signatures for distinguishing the neutral case from the charged one through the frequency profile of the stochastic gravitational-wave background.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了对称破缺暴胀模型中由标量场诱导的引力波，并关注其可探测性及频率特征，与脉冲星计时阵列领域相关。
decision.title_zh: 对称破缺暴胀中的标量诱导引力波
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了对称破缺暴胀模型中由标量场诱导的引力波（SIGWs），其中带电标量场通过动力学函数与各向同性的阿贝尔规范场三重态耦合。当暴胀子与规范场扰动之间的混合足够大时，此类SIGWs可增强至可探测水平。我们发现，只有当规范场激发在暴胀期间足够晚发生时，纵向模式和扰动间依赖于电荷的混合才变得重要。在这种情况下，相应的SIGWs被移至超高频段，通常可达GHz波段。我们表明，描述纵向模式和依赖于电荷的混合效应的参数以定性不同的方式影响信号。这为通过随机引力波背景的频率特征区分中性情况与带电情况提供了特征性标志。
